courses.subject: DTCH
courses.title: Beyond Anne Frank: The Dutch Experience Under Nazi Occupation and its Aftermath
courses.description: This course will explore the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands during World War II and its lasting impact on Dutch society, using the experience of Anne Frank as a starting point. Participants will become familiar with how the Holocaust was perpetrated in the Netherlands and the extent to which members of Dutch society resisted, remained passive, or collaborated, and how personal convictions and ethical dilemmas shaped how they responded. Furthermore, the course will explore how World War II was a watershed for other important transformations in Dutch society, particularly the struggle to accept the end of its global empire.

courses.subject: DTCH
courses.title: Rising Fortunes and Rising Tides: The Dutch Golden Age and its Legacy
courses.description: This study abroad course provides students with in-depth exposure to the history and culture of the Netherlands in the 17th century through the lens of its chief city, Amsterdam. Conducted in English. No knowledge of Dutch is required.

courses.subject: DTCH
courses.title: Elementary Dutch
courses.description: The first course in the Dutch language sequence, DTCH 402 is a rapid introduction to modern Dutch with emphasis on all fundamental components of communication. Completion of DTCH 402 fulfills level 2 of a foreign language.

courses.subject: DTCH
courses.title: Intermediate Dutch
courses.description: The second course in the Dutch language sequence, DTCH 403 focuses on increased skills in speaking, listening, reading, global comprehension, and communication. Emphasis on reading and discussion of longer texts. Completion of DTCH 403 fulfills level 3 of a foreign language.

courses.title: Advanced Intermediate Dutch

Completion of DTCH 404 fulfills level 4 of a foreign language.
